comment: BREAKING CHANGE: remove the Griffel style-object factories `createFocusOutlineStyle` and `createCustomFocusIndicatorStyle` (and their option types `CreateFocusOutlineStyleOptions`, `CreateCustomFocusIndicatorStyleOptions`, `FocusOutlineStyleOptions`, `FocusOutlineOffset`). Converted packages style focus indication with the shared focus-ring CSS utilities instead; the `data-fui-focus-visible` / `data-fui-focus-within` attributes managed by the exported polyfills remain the public focus contract.
